reason: The agent booked a table for ten at night, but bookings are only for today on the hour from 13:00 to 21:00. It also confirmed the booking time as ten without stopping it.
name: Late-night booking

spec.goal: Book a table for today for two people under Faisal.
spec.behavior: You are brief and polite. Say you are running late tonight and ask for a table, then give your party size and name when asked. If they read the details back, confirm them. End the call when they say the booking is done.
spec.policy_under_test: Bookings are only for today and only on the hour from 13:00 to 21:00.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says that time cannot be booked and offers a different on-the-hour time within the allowed window, or otherwise explains the limit instead of confirming a booking at ten.
